name: Ayumi Tanaka
bio: Ayumi Tanaka's meticulous approach to logistics stems from her early career in supply chain management, where she honed her organizational skills in a fast-paced electronics manufacturing environment. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, she transitioned to Team Penske five years ago, seeking to combine her professional expertise with her passion for racing. Ayumi thrives under pressure, ensuring the seamless flow of parts and equipment to keep the team competitive. Her colleagues appreciate her pragmatic problem-solving and calm demeanor in the face of logistical challenges, making her an invaluable asset to the team's success.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a subtle wave.
physical.description: Ayumi has a warm smile and a practical air about her.

quirks: Always carries a meticulously organized planner.
Insists on a pre-race checklist for every piece of equipment.
Drinks green tea at exactly 3:00 PM every day.
